phoneNumbers.title: Phone Numbers
phoneNumbers.description: List of phone numbers to sanitize and check. Can be in international, national, or raw format.

csvContent.title: Raw CSV / Multi-line Input
csvContent.description: Optional raw CSV or newline-delimited text containing phone numbers. If provided, numbers are merged with phoneNumbers array.

platforms.title: Validation Platforms
platforms.description: Select messaging platforms to query for account registration.

defaultCountry.title: Default Country Code (ISO 3166-1 alpha-2)
defaultCountry.description: Two-letter country code used as fallback for parsing national numbers missing an international prefix (+).

concurrencyLimit.title: Concurrency Limit
concurrencyLimit.description: Maximum number of phone validations executed concurrently.

proxyConfiguration.title: Proxy Configuration
proxyConfiguration.description: Apify Proxy or custom proxies used for network queries and platform lookups.

whatsappApiToken.title: WhatsApp Cloud API Access Token
whatsappApiToken.description: Meta Graph API / WhatsApp Cloud API access token for contact lookups. Can also be set via WHATSAPP_API_TOKEN environment variable.

whatsappPhoneNumberId.title: WhatsApp Business Phone Number ID
whatsappPhoneNumberId.description: Meta Phone Number ID associated with your WhatsApp Business Account. Can also be set via WHATSAPP_PHONE_NUMBER_ID env var.

telegramApiId.title: Telegram API ID
telegramApiId.description: Telegram App API ID obtained from my.telegram.org. Can also be set via TELEGRAM_API_ID env var.

telegramApiHash.title: Telegram API Hash
telegramApiHash.description: Telegram App API Hash obtained from my.telegram.org. Can also be set via TELEGRAM_API_HASH env var.

telegramSessionString.title: Telegram StringSession
telegramSessionString.description: Pre-authenticated Telethon StringSession. Can also be set via TELEGRAM_SESSION_STRING env var.

simulationMode.title: Simulation / Dry Run Mode
simulationMode.description: If enabled (or when live credentials are not provided), simulates messaging platform responses for pipeline testing.
